description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, with no length limit, and returns the destination pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:1E12
name: copy_string_or_pad
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer up to a count given as the third argument. When the count is zero it instead fills the destination with zero bytes, and the result is null terminated.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:1E42
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values modulo 2 to the power 32, using 16-bit partial products. It returns the product in the first result register and leaves the second argument in the other.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:1E66
name: format_string_with_percent_codes
description: Copies literal bytes from a format string into a destination buffer and expands percent codes using flags, widths and digit tables for upper and lower case number output. It returns the number of bytes written, or minus one on error.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:235E
name: measure_zero_terminated_string
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string and returns how many bytes come before the terminator. It does not write to memory.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2370
name: call_routine_per_table_entry
description: Walks a table of 22-byte records between two fixed global addresses and calls a routine on each record in turn. It returns nothing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2396
name: write_byte_to_buffered_record
description: Writes one byte to a buffered record after checking its status flags, and a null record gives minus one. It stores the byte into free buffer space, flushing through another routine when needed, and returns the byte in that normal case or a count otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2516
name: close_record_and_reset_fields
description: Closes a valid record that has a non-zero status, calling routines to flush or release its buffer, and writes a set numeric field as five decimal digits first. It then clears the record fields and returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2538
name: close_record_and_reset_fields
description: Closes a record with a non-zero status, calling routines to flush or release its buffer, and writes a set numeric field as five decimal digits first. It then clears the record fields and returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:25DA
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero without doing anything else, and it makes no calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:25E4
name: apply_to_record_or_all
description: With no argument, it walks the record table and calls a routine with a minus-one argument on each active record that lacks certain flag bits, returning minus one if any such call returns minus one. With a record argument, it makes that single call and returns its result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2622
name: scan_record_table_for_failure
description: Scans the record table from its start and calls a routine with a minus-one argument on each active record that lacks certain flag bits. It returns minus one at the first call that fails and zero when the table is exhausted.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2634
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without using its result or changing anything else. The facts list callee routines, but they do not show that the callee is the routine itself.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2642
name: call_and_return_pair
description: Calls another routine and returns a 64-bit pair made from the original second register and the value the call left in the second register.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:266A
name: apply_sign_around_call
description: Records the sign of its two register arguments, calls another routine on the values, and negates that result when the signs call for it. It returns the adjusted result together with the second argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2684
name: negate_result_by_sign
description: Calls another routine and then negates its second result when the first register argument is negative. It returns the adjusted value together with the second argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2690
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without using its result or changing anything else. The facts list callee routines, but they do not show that the callee is the routine itself.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:269A
name: divide_32_bit_quotient_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend in the first register by a 32-bit divisor in the second. It uses a 16-step shift-subtract loop when the divisor is larger than 16 bits, and a direct 16-bit division otherwise, returning the quotient and remainder as a 64-bit pair.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:26EA
name: init_buffer_record_fields
description: Initialises a record's fields, calling another routine to choose the buffering mode. It requests a 1024-byte buffer and sets the buffer pointers and status flags from the result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2760
name: unlink_and_free_list_entry
description: Searches a global linked list for the given entry and unlinks it when found, then calls a library routine on it. It returns the result of that call, or zero when the entry is not in the list.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:27A8
name: walk_list_and_clear_head
description: Walks a global linked list and makes a library call for each entry with the same argument register, then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:27B2
name: walk_list_and_clear_head
description: Walks a global linked list and makes a library call for each entry with the same argument register, then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:27D8
name: allocate_and_link_list_record
description: When given a non-zero argument, it allocates a record through a library call and, if that succeeds, links the record onto the front of a global list and stores the argument in it. It returns the address just past the two header words, or null when nothing was allocated.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2822
name: copy_string_to_destination
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into a destination buffer, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer. The copy has no length limit.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2830
name: check_entry_is_interactive
description: Checks a numbered table entry: an out-of-range or empty index stores error code 3 and returns minus one. Otherwise it asks the dos library whether that handle is interactive and returns one when it is, and zero otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2892
name: seek_entry_and_record_error
description: Checks a numbered table entry, storing error code 3 and returning minus one when the index is out of range or the entry is empty. Otherwise it calls the dos library seek routine; if that fails it reads the error code with IoErr into a global field and returns minus one, and on success it returns the seek result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2922
name: delete_file_or_record_error
description: Calls the dos library DeleteFile routine with its argument. When that fails it stores the IoErr result as the error code and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2954
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero without doing anything else, and it makes no calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2958
name: write_record_and_report_error
description: Checks a numbered table entry, storing error code 3 for an invalid index or code 6 when the entry's mode bits are clear. It may seek to the entry first when a flag bit is set, then writes through the dos library, storing the IoErr value and returning minus one if the write fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2A06
name: check_flag_bits_and_return
description: Calls a library routine that returns a flag word and tests bit 4096. When that bit is set and a stored field is zero it returns the flag word; when the field is non-zero it calls another routine and returns zero, and when the bit is clear it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2A3C
name: write_global_word_to_output
description: Writes the four bytes of a global variable to the standard output through the dos library, makes one more library call, and calls another routine with the argument one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2A76
name: run_list_hooks_then_finish
description: Walks a global linked list, calling a function pointer stored four bytes into each entry and advancing to the next entry. It then calls a global function pointer when one is set, and passes its argument on to another routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2AA8
name: release_resources_and_unlock
description: Releases global resources in order: when a table exists it calls a routine for each index up to a global count, then calls library routines that free and release handles and records. It checks several global fields to decide which calls to make, and it finishes with a call that depends on a bit in a global flags field.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2C02
name: return_without_action
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, with no calls and no effect on its arguments.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:InstallCrypt:0:2C08
name: close_indexed_entry_handle
description: Checks a numbered table entry, storing error code 3 and returning minus one when the index is out of range or the entry is empty. Otherwise it calls the dos library Close routine unless a flag bit is set, clears the entry and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0000
name: clear_state_block_and_start
description: Zeroes sixty-seven 32-bit words of global state, stores a register value in a field, and tests a flag bit that may call a library routine. A library call whose result decides between a second library call and another routine ends the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0004
name: handle_workbench_and_disk_loop
description: Closes and reopens the Workbench interface around a lock on the game disk volume, taking the current directory first. It then loops over input messages from a port, and a switch on the message type handles cases zero to three by updating fields or calling further routines, ending the loop when a case sets its exit value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:028C
name: open_screen_window_and_config
description: Clears a set of global handles and opens the graphics and intuition libraries, then loads a configuration file and sets up bitmap and colour data. It opens a screen and a window, brings the screen to the front, and the text references BCMain, BCExit, Configuration.Dat, graphics.library and intuition.library.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0546
name: close_screen_window_and_free
description: Closes the screen and window handles when their global fields are set, calling intuition routines and library free routines through stored base pointers. It finishes with calls that release the remaining handles and a final cleanup call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0600
name: delay_then_unload_segment
description: Sets a status value of six in a record, makes one library call, and passes a stored handle to another routine. It then calls the dos library to delay and to unload a code segment, and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0656
name: poll_input_events_until_done
description: Loops calling an input routine and switches on the event type. Type one stores a derived code in a global field when a condition holds and calls a handler, types two and three call handlers, and type four sets the return value to one and ends the loop.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0704
name: copy_uppercase_name_then_colon
description: Copies a name from an indexed table entry into a buffer, using the stored length and substituting zero above 33. It converts lowercase letters to uppercase, then appends a colon and a null terminator and returns the length.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0776
name: scan_entries_for_failure
description: Walks a linked list of entries and, for each entry with a non-zero flag, calls a routine with a stored field and a second routine with the argument through a 120-byte stack buffer. It returns one if any second call returns zero and otherwise zero, bracketed by two library calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:07F8
name: prompt_insert_disk_wait_messages
description: Returns a stored value when a global flag is set; otherwise it checks the path and, when that fails, copies the path into a buffer with a colon, shows the PLEASE INSERT DISK prompt with a delay, and loops over port messages until a message of class 32768 triggers another check.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:098E
name: wait_for_library_result
description: Repeatedly calls one library routine, then reads a second library routine's result, and loops until that result is non-zero. It returns that non-zero result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:09D2
name: load_segment_and_create_process
description: Loads a code segment and, when that succeeds, creates a process from it, storing the process and segment handles and clearing three fields. It then looks up an entry, compares its field with the second argument, and sets its status value to six, with the text naming BC Game and GAMEDISK1.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0A62
name: set_entry_status_six
description: Looks up an entry through a subroutine, stores its field into a global slot, and sets its status to six after comparing its state with a value from the caller's record. It makes two library calls around that step and looks the entry up again.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0AE8
name: load_run_and_unload_segment
description: Loads a segment through the dos library and, when the load succeeds, calls a function pointer stored in a global with arguments derived from the segment's length. It then unloads the segment and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0B56
name: call_routine_per_character
description: Makes two calls, then calls another routine once for each character of a zero-terminated string argument before returning.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0BC4
name: return_without_action
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, with no calls and no effect on its arguments.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0BCC
name: call_routine_per_character
description: Calls one routine with its argument, then calls another routine once for each character of a zero-terminated string argument before returning.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0C2C
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, without any other work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0C3C
name: clear_blit_area_then_call
description: Calls one routine, then makes a call through a global block pointer at minus 300 bytes and returns. The facts record a graphics.BltClear library call among this routine's calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0C64
name: write_menu_labels_then_return
description: Calls two routines with fixed numeric arguments several times, then returns five. The referenced text is a set of menu captions: CONFIGURATION MENU, CREATE NEW PARTY, EXIT TO AMIGADOS, LOAD GAME and MAIN MENU.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0E4A
name: poll_input_for_slot
description: Polls a message port until it finds a message of class eight with code 104 whose position maps onto a slot, and returns that slot number. The slot is limited by the argument, and an out-of-range position returns one only when the argument is ten.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:0F40
name: dispatch_by_event_code
description: Clears a blit area through a graphics function pointer, then dispatches on a numeric code: codes one, two, three, four and six each call a different subroutine. It makes one more call and returns that call's result as a 16-bit value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:18B0
name: store_registers_into_globals
description: Writes the first two data-register values and a third register into three fixed global locations. It makes no calls and returns no value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:23DE
name: copy_block_to_strided_rows
description: Copies eight bytes from a source block into a destination at offsets from zero to 280 in steps of 40, then repeats the copy six times with the destination advanced by 8000 bytes each time.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2442
name: scan_global_array_twice
description: Scans a global byte array in two passes, two bytes at a time. In the first pass it makes two calls for each entry whose high bit is clear, and in the second pass it makes one call, stopping at a null byte in the second position of each pair.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:26D2
name: run_sixteen_step_loop
description: Runs a loop sixteen times, making two calls through a function pointer, one routine call and one call through a second pointer on each pass. The facts list library calls at minus 192 and minus 270 for this routine, but the shown pseudo-code does not name them.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2712
name: decrement_nibbles_in_word_list
description: Walks a list of 16-bit words, with the count taken from the first register, and decrements each of the three low-order nibbles that is non-zero. It writes each updated word back in place.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:274A
name: run_sixteen_step_loop
description: Runs a loop sixteen times, making two calls through a function pointer, one routine call and one call through a second pointer on each pass. The facts list library calls at minus 192 and minus 270 for this routine, but the shown pseudo-code does not name them.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2790
name: increment_nibbles_where_differing
description: Walks two lists of 16-bit words together for a count taken from the first register. For each pair it increments the three low-order nibbles of the first word wherever they differ from the second, then writes the result back into the first list.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2860
name: copy_byte_array
description: Copies a given number of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer, one byte at a time, and returns the destination pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:287E
name: compare_zero_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated byte strings and returns one when the first sorts after the second, minus one when it sorts before, and zero when they are equal. The facts also list exec Alert, OldOpenLibrary and Supervisor calls, which the shown pseudo-code does not include.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2914
name: return_without_action
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, with no calls and no effect on its arguments.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:291C
name: open_standard_streams_with_tag
description: Allocates a block with a library call and returns early if that fails. Otherwise it sets fixed fields in the block, writes a four-character tag into a buffer, and opens standard input and output through the dos library, then passes the result to another routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2AAE
name: parse_quoted_arguments_into_buffer
description: Allocates a buffer with a library call and, when that succeeds, copies a name and an argument string into it. It then scans the text skipping spaces, tabs, form feeds and line breaks, and treats a double quote as the start of a quoted token.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2AB0
name: parse_quoted_arguments_into_buffer
description: Allocates a buffer with a library call and, when that succeeds, copies a name and an argument string into it. It then scans the text skipping spaces, tabs, form feeds and line breaks, and treats a double quote as the start of a quoted token.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2C6C
name: append_string_with_count_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the count given in the third argument. It then null-terminates the result and returns the destination pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2C6E
name: append_string_with_count_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the count given in the third argument. It then null-terminates the result and returns the destination pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2C92
name: read_icon_window_entry
description: Opens a library and, when the lookup succeeds, calls icon library routines to read a window entry and store its values in the caller's record. It then closes the library, and the text refers to WINDOW and icon.library.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2D7C
name: append_string_to_destination
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, with no length limit, and returns the destination pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2D92
name: copy_string_or_pad
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer up to a count given as the third argument. When the count is zero it instead fills the destination with zero bytes, and the result is null terminated.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2DC2
name: allocate_and_init_record
description: Calls a library routine for an identifier and returns zero when that is minus one; otherwise it allocates a record, calls a library routine on it and returns zero if the allocation fails. On success it fills in the argument, a byte argument, a fixed flag byte and a status byte, stores a library result, and calls a subroutine or a library routine depending on the argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2E64
name: reset_record_and_release
description: If a record's pointer field is set, it calls a library routine on it. It then sets a status byte to 255 and a long field to minus one, and finishes by calling two library routines, one with the record and one with the register argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2EB6
name: measure_zero_terminated_string
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string and returns how many bytes come before the terminator. It does not write to memory.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2EC8
name: setup_self_linked_header
description: Stores the record's own address plus four in its first word, clears its second word, and stores the record address in its third word. It makes no calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2EDA
name: copy_string_to_destination
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into a destination buffer, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer. The copy has no length limit.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2EE8
name: run_list_hooks_then_finish
description: Walks a global linked list, calling a function pointer stored four bytes into each entry and advancing to the next entry. It then calls a global function pointer when one is set, and passes its argument on to another routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:2F1A
name: release_resources_and_unlock
description: Releases global resources in order: when a table exists it calls a routine for each index up to a global count, then calls library routines that free and release handles and records. It checks several global fields to decide which calls to make, and it finishes with a call that depends on a bit in a global flags field.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:3074
name: return_without_action
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, with no calls and no effect on its arguments.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:BlackCrypt:0:307A
name: close_indexed_entry_handle
description: Checks a numbered table entry, storing error code 3 and returning minus one when the index is out of range or the entry is empty. Otherwise it calls the dos library Close routine unless a flag bit is set, clears the entry and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0000
name: clear_state_block_and_start
description: Zeroes 494 32-bit words of global state, stores a register value in a field, and tests a flag bit that may call a library routine. A library call whose result decides between a second library call and another routine ends the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0004
name: open_graphics_intuition_libraries
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries and, when either open fails, calls an error routine with a message from the text table. It then stores the handles, makes further library calls to wait and to clean up, and the text references BCMain, BCSub and both library names.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0132
name: initialize_block_and_release
description: Calls one library routine, then passes a pointer from a global slot to another routine and makes two more library calls with that pointer before returning.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0186
name: copy_list_records_by_flag
description: Walks a linked list of 20-byte records held in a table, copying each record into a buffer with a routine that takes a 20-byte count and advancing the buffer pointer. It calls a further routine for records whose type byte is 19 or 35.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:022A
name: initialize_four_entity_structures
description: Loops four times over entity structures, clearing their 16-bit arrays and setting a few byte fields. Entries one to three also receive fixed byte values, a stored byte is copied across, and each entry calls a subroutine with its address and a value from a global table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0816
name: initialize_entity_arrays
description: Loops four times filling per-entry 16-bit fields with values computed from the loop index, and sums attribute values from a global table into a per-entry long. It then sets several global 16-bit fields and clears a block of memory.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:09DC
name: save_character_data_to_file
description: Writes character configuration data to a file: it opens the file, writes padding and header blocks, and writes four character slots with their tables and status fields. It closes the file afterward, and the text refers to CHARACTERS.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0E14
name: wait_for_library_result
description: Repeatedly calls one library routine, then reads a second library routine's result, and loops until that result is non-zero. It returns that non-zero result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0E58
name: run_library_call_state_zero
description: Sets a global state word to zero, makes one library call through a global block and calls a routine. It calls a further routine when the state word is not six afterward.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0E90
name: run_library_call_state_two
description: Sets a global state word to two, makes one library call through a global block and calls a routine. It calls a further routine when the state word is not six afterward.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0ECC
name: run_library_call_state_eight
description: Sets a global state word to eight, makes one library call through a global block and calls a routine. It calls a further routine when the state word is not six afterward.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0F08
name: run_library_call_state_three
description: Sets a global state word to three and stores its argument in a global, then makes a library call through a global block and calls a routine, with a further call when the state word is not six. It then duplicates a lock, unlocks it through the dos library and calls a function pointer, with an optional final call when a second library result is non-zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0F96
name: run_library_call_state_seven
description: Sets a global state word to seven and stores its argument in a global. It makes a library call through a global block, calls a routine, and calls a further routine when the state word is not six, then returns the stored argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:0FDC
name: run_library_call_state_ten
description: Sets a global state word to ten and stores two arguments in globals. It makes a library call through a global block, calls a routine, and calls a further routine when the state word is not six.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:102E
name: transfer_dungeon_save_files
description: Reads and writes save data through the dos library, opening files on the game disk and save paths, transferring blocks, and waiting briefly. It returns one when the first open fails and two when a stored status value does not match, and the text refers to GAMEDISK1:, GAMESAVE:, OrigDungeons and TempDungeons.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1248
name: check_disk_space_and_prompt
description: Locks the game disk volume through the dos library and checks the disk status in a loop, selecting one of two prompts for a status of one or two. It then unlocks the disk and restores a stored value, and the text refers to DISK IS and DISK IS FULL.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:139A
name: dispatch_sprite_by_type
description: Loops over a sprite record and dispatches on its type value. Types two and eight each take one of several branches chosen by the position value, calling rendering subroutines, and the loop ends when a case sets its exit flag.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:14DA
name: setup_sprite_rendering_loop
description: Stores zero in a global field and makes a series of subroutine calls. It then loops four times with a nested loop of six subroutine calls per pass, passing the loop index to each subroutine, and finishes with a further set of subroutine calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1668
name: call_routine_nine_times
description: Calls one routine nine times in a loop and returns, without other work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:16CA
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without using its result or changing anything else. The facts list callee routines, but they do not show that the callee is the routine itself.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:171E
name: store_sprite_offset_and_call
description: Computes a value from a global index and a second global field, stores it into a per-entry field of a global table, then calls subroutines with the index. It returns after those calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:176A
name: configure_sprite_rendering_params
description: Calls subroutines with fixed numeric arguments and with a value computed from a global index, stores its argument into a global index field, then makes further subroutine calls. It returns after the final call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1806
name: dispatch_sprite_rendering
description: Checks a global index against a field and calls a subroutine when they differ. It then calls a subroutine and switches on its result from one to ten, calling one of two subroutines for each value, and finishes with three more calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1908
name: check_range_overlap
description: Searches ten entries in a global table of 16-bit coordinate pairs for one whose box contains the argument, testing the low half of the argument within thirteen units of the entry's first value and the high half within nine of its second. It returns the entry index plus one, or zero when none matches.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:196E
name: update_counters_when_conditions_met
description: When a table value for the given index is not twenty and a second value is non-zero, it increments one counter and decrements another, then calls two subroutines. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1AD2
name: call_helpers_by_tens_value
description: Reads a 16-bit value from a per-entry table, divides it by ten, and makes three subroutine calls when the quotient is zero or two subroutine calls otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1BEC
name: process_entry_field_calls
description: Calls a subroutine with the address of an entry field in a per-entry table, then calls another subroutine with a value derived from the entry index. It makes further calls depending on whether the field is non-zero and on a second argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1CD8
name: clear_entry_flag_and_refresh
description: Reads a value for the current entry and, when it is non-zero, checks two flag bits returned by subroutine calls. It clears either the byte at the index before that value or the entry's first byte, then calls subroutines in sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1D0E
name: clear_entry_flag_and_refresh
description: Checks two flag bits from subroutine calls and clears either the entry's byte at the index before a stored value or its first byte, then calls subroutines to refresh the entry.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1D3E
name: clear_entry_byte_and_refresh
description: Clears the entry byte just before a stored index, then calls subroutines with a value of one to refresh the entry.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1D8E
name: store_entry_byte_and_refresh
description: Reads a subroutine value for the current entry and, when it is not twelve and a second subroutine returns non-zero, stores that second value as a byte in the entry and writes a zero byte after it. It then calls subroutines to refresh the entry.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:1E42
name: search_short_table
description: Searches a global table of 26 16-bit values for the argument and returns its index plus 65 when found, or zero when not found.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:200E
name: call_routine_then_library_vector
description: Calls one routine, then calls a library routine at a fixed negative offset of 198 bytes from a global base, and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2036
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls one routine, then makes an exec library allocation call through a global base. It returns without storing the result of that call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2068
name: allocate_and_open_graphics_library
description: Allocates a block through the exec library and returns one when that fails. Otherwise it stores the argument and a fixed hardware address in the block, opens the graphics library, fills further blocks from a pointer table, and fills trailing fields with a running sum of table values before returning a status value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:214C
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, without any other work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2178
name: process_pair_list_with_library
description: Calls a library routine at offset minus 30 through a global base, then walks a list of pairs until the second word of a pair is minus one, calling a library routine at minus 42 for each pair. It finishes with a library call at minus 36.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:21BC
name: return_without_action
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, with no calls and no effect on its arguments.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:21CA
name: cleanup_allocated_memory
description: Walks two tables of function pointers and global slots, calling a routine for each entry that is set. It then frees a memory block through the exec library, closes a library when one is open, and finishes with a final library call.
